Im heutigen fußballerischen Volksmund bezeichnet man sie auch als „Unterhaus“, während die 1. Liga „Oberhaus“ genannt wird. Etabliert wurde die 2. programme.title: Fußball: Bundesliga der Frauen
programme.desc: Die Frauen-Bundesliga ist die höchste Spielklasse im deutschen Fußball für jene, die sich selbst als Frau identifizieren. Etabliert wurde die Liga 1989 durch den DFB-Bundestag, im Jahr darauf wurde der Spielbetrieb in zwei Staffeln zu je zehn Mannschaften aufgenommen. Seit 1997 wird die Frauen-Bundesliga bundesweit nach dem Vorbild der Männer eingleisig, jedoch mit nur zwölf Mannschaften ausgetrag

programme.title: PL MOMENTS - EP7
programme.desc: Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. This week, the Dutch international sits down wit

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP14
programme.desc: One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Cech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP20
programme.desc: Once the last line of defence, today's goalkeeper is expected to be so much more. From sweeper-keepers to playing out under pressure, we explore the innovations, characters and changing demands that have revolutionised one of football's most fascinating positions.

programme.title: NETBUSTERS - MW10 - EP10
programme.desc: A fast-paced music and commentary driven ISO angle highlights show featuring every game and every goal from each match round.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP10
programme.desc: Michael Owen burst onto the scene for Liverpool at just seventeen years of age, and in two consecutive seasons the teenage sensation won the Premier League Golden Boot. Owen recalls those campaigns for the Reds, reliving the key moments that helped him develop into one of the greatest players of his generation.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP5
programme.desc: At just 16 years old, Theo Walcott attracted the attention of Arsene Wenger, who brought the electric youngster to Arsenal. The Englishman bagged over 100 goals for the Gunners, becoming one of their most prolific Premier League stars. He recalls the key moments and matches from 12 years in north London.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP24
programme.desc: We explore Mikel Arteta's impact at Arsenal and the managerial approach behind his success, reflecting on how his upbringing and football education in the Basque region shaped his thinking. We examine his tactics, how he develops players and the standards he sets throughout the club. We look at the key decisions that have turned Arsenal into Premier League champions.

programme.title: REVIEW OF THE SEASON - 2016/2017 (CHE)
programme.desc: A review of all the best goals, action and drama from Premier League seasons past.

With everything on the line, he soon finds himself trying to whip a hot new roster of talented dancers into shape.
